comment: Only EXT reads more than one channel, and it sums them: there is a single lattice, so the module is monophonic. The manual's control table gives RATE as the ring's restoring rate and calls it subtle against COUPLE; the code bears that out — the centering coefficient is scaled by the step divider, so RATE only becomes a strong control in Slow mode. The manual writes the third bottom-row jack as EXT IN; the panel prints EXT.
